argv.executable_identity: platform-selected pdfalto or pdfalto_server basename; physical path redacted
argv.input_output: source PDF and temporary XML are positional arguments; values are not persisted

execution.thread_mode: ProcessRunner with optional join timeout; Unix-like hosts wrap argv with ulimit -Sv and exec
execution.server_mode: ProcessPdfToXml.process with pdfalto_server and explicit timeout/ulimit
execution.timeout_default: unknown: legacy constant commented out; configured timeout is external to this source contract
execution.memory_limit: unknown: configured GrobidProperties value; numeric value intentionally not invented
execution.temporary_xml: generated in configured temp area with opaque key and .lxml suffix; cleanupXml enabled for fromPdf
execution.data_cleanup: close removes XML and optional _data, annotation, and outline sidecars according to cleanup flags

identity.md5: DocumentSource stores caller-supplied MD5 string; no digest is computed by this boundary
identity.source_identity: PDF file identity is carried by the source object; physical path is redacted

layout_topology.page: 1-based source page marker is mapped to zero-based Rust ordinal by the shadow contract
layout_topology.visual_element: Illustration remains visual evidence and is not lexicalized
layout_topology.lexical_order: SAX source order with a newline boundary emitted at TextLine end
layout_topology.coordinates: ALTO HPOS/VPOS/WIDTH/HEIGHT are source geometry; target normalization is declared separately by layout_lattice_parity.v1
layout_topology.empty_or_null: Java logs and does not add null/empty blocks; shadow evidence must account for these as typed outcomes
